purpose: Measure fixed-shape CUDA resource reuse for one exact tiled histogram workload
first_sample: iteration zero retained separately, not a cold-process measurement
order: for iteration k and condition c, rotate the six backend indices by (k+c) modulo six; two additional warmup rounds after iteration zero
context_setup: one context per bin method per shape and distribution, recorded before repeated execution after device discovery
context_retirement: explicit close and destruction recorded after all iterations of the condition
host_timing: steady_clock entry through return of an owned completed result; includes validation, host result allocation, current-input H2D, kernel, D2H and synchronization; simple calls include resource cleanup; reused calls retain their resources
outside_host_timing: full output comparison against independent histogram oracle
device_timing: same-stream upload, kernel and download events, not summed with host elapsed time
correctness: every recorded and warmup output compared bin-for-bin with an independent pixel-to-tile oracle; checksum and request ID retained
scope: same host source, inputs and output semantics; no Python, queue, device-resident or asynchronous contract
environment: record CPU, GPU, driver, compiler, OS, source/protocol/binary identities and before/after utilization; preserve ordinary applications and default settings
decision: retain slower and neutral results, keep simple API default unless the bounded evidence justifies recommending repeated context use
historical_evidence: leave all original 504 timing rows and protocols unchanged
